name: Dodge Falling Rocks

meta.name: Dodge Falling Rocks
meta.tagline: Watch the sky and move before the rocks land.
meta.description: Move along the ground to avoid rocks falling from above. Survive as long as you can, and watch each rock’s position and speed to plan a safe path.

rewardTerms.description: Fraction of the episode limit survived.
Fraction of an expected episode's rocks passed safely.
One if a falling rock hits the player.
Fraction of steps spent moving left or right.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Survive and dodge rocks without needless movement.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Prioritize staying alive and moving only when needed.

human.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to dodge. Stay still to hold your position.
